correctedState: Confirmed absent, with three corrections to the finding's prose. (a) The claim 'grep -ran "skills-dir" over the repo hits only plan/spec prose' is false: there are live non-prose hits -- `packages/shared/src/config/watcher.ts:511` (debounce key), `packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/manifest-paths.ts:30` plus `__tests__/manifest-paths.test.ts:85` and `__tests__/format-adapters.test.ts:3497-3509` (a `custom-skills-dir` fixture), and `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/managed-marketplace-entries.test.ts:56`, which asserts a managed-policy `{ source: 'skills-dir' }` entry is dropped as invalid. None implement the feature, so the conclusion holds, but the absence must be stated against the code path, not against the grep. (b) The claim that 'skill discovery walks `.claude/skills` at project and ancestor depth (native-sources.ts line ~1065)' names the wrong directory. `native-sources.ts:1065` walks `PROJECT_AGENT_SKILLS_DIR` = `.agents/skills` (`packages/shared/src/skills/storage.ts:37`); the other four `skillRecords` call sites are `~/.agents/skills` (`:903`), `<configDir>/skills` (`:904`), `<workspaceRoot>/skills` (`:949`) and `.nessy-agent/skills` (`:1016`). `.claude/skills` is not scanned anywhere in the fork -- `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/settings.local.json` and `.claude/rules` are read beside ours (`:1049`-`:1058`, `:1108`), but `.claude/skills` is not among them. (c) The stated consequence is conditionally wrong and understates the gap. Because `skillRecords` admits a folder only when `<folder>/SKILL.md` exists (`native-sources.ts:282`), a doc-conformant skills-directory plugin -- which per `plugins/org.md#keep-skills-directory-plugins-loading (was line 382 of the retired plugins-reference page)` bundles its skills at `<folder>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` and need have no root `SKILL.md` at all -- contributes NOTHING, not 'its SKILL.md minus the agents/hooks/MCP'. Only the subset of such bundles that happen to also carry a root `SKILL.md` degrade to a bare skill. Corrected statement: the fork has no in-place plugin discovery of any kind; every plugin must be resolved through `install-service.ts` and staged into the plugin cache (including the `local-path` source kind), so `<skills-dir>/<name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` is never read, `<name>@skills-dir` is never a plugin key, `plugin init` is deliberately not implemented (`apps/cli/src/plugin.ts:39` routes it to `/create-plugin` and the bundled `plugin-creator` skill), there is no `/reload-plugins`, and the doc's admin control for the source -- `{"source": "skills-dir"}` in `blockedMarketplaces`/`strictKnownMarketplaces` (`plugins/marketplace-reference.md#source-values-valid-only-in-policy-lists (was line 911 of the retired plugins-reference page)`) -- is parsed as an invalid entry and dropped (`managed-marketplace-entries.test.ts:56`). The item was listed under parity row B1, never measured in `2026-07-29-b1-audit.md`, and silently dropped when B1 was declared closed at `6cdbd80e`; it has no plan and no owner decision.
